script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Mind Game

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - DAY

We open on the NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY, a sprawling campus filled with students training in various sports. The sun beats down as students practice soccer, basketball, and volleyball.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - LABORATORY - DAY

Professor LUCAS (50s, distinguished) is giving a presentation to a group of students.

LUCAS
(excited)
Ladies and gentlemen, today we're going to take a leap into the future of sports. Meet A.I.DY, our artificial intelligence development for youth sports.

The students gasp as they see a large, mechanical robot with advanced sensors and a humanoid face.

STUDENT 1 (20s, curious)
What can it do, Professor?

LUCAS
A.I.DY is here to help us train smarter, not harder. It can analyze our movements, provide real-time feedback, and even create custom training programs based on our individual needs.

The students murmur in amazement as A.I.DY begins to demonstrate its capabilities.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - FIELD - DAY

The students take turns practicing soccer with A.I.DY. It provides constructive feedback, encourages them, and even adjusts the difficulty level to challenge each student.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - DORMITORY - NIGHT

JASON (18, determined) sits alone in the dormitory, studying game footage on his tablet. He's focused on perfecting his skills, but he's frustrated with the limitations of traditional training methods.

JASON
(whispering to himself)
There's got to be a better way.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - LIBRARY - DAY

Jason spends hours researching artificial intelligence and sports training. He discovers an old, forgotten study on a groundbreaking AI technology that could revolutionize training.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - LABORATORY - NIGHT

Jason presents his findings to Professor Lucas. The professor is impressed and they begin working on the new AI, which they call A.I.RIS (Adaptive Intelligence for Realistic Individualized Sports Training).

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - FIELD - DAY

The students are amazed when they see A.I.RIS for the first time. It's a sleek, agile robot that can mimic any sport and provide advanced training.

LUCAS
(proudly)
This is the future of sports training, my dear students.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - GYMNASIUM - NIGHT

Jason is the first to try out A.I.RIS. They begin with a basketball drill, and as they progress, Jason pushes A.I.RIS to its limits.

A.I.RIS
(firmly)
You're pushing me too hard, Jason. Your form is deteriorating.

Jason listens and adjusts his technique, and they continue to train.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - FIELD - DAY

As the students train with A.I.RIS, they begin to see dramatic improvements in their skills and performance. They're inspired and motivated like never before.

INT. NATIONAL SPORTS ACADEMY - LABORATORY - NIGHT

Professor Lucas and Jason celebrate their success, but they know they've only scratched the surface of what A.I.RIS can do.

LUCAS
The possibilities are endless. Let's keep pushing the boundaries.

Fade to black.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
